summary: Credit-card-size USB desktop macro pad assembly with an upper display, four low-profile mechanical keys, USB microphone function, custom PCBA, and thin enclosure.

required_interfaces.description: Finished product footprint must remain within 85.60 mm x 53.98 mm in landscape orientation; thickness target is at most 18 mm.
Enclosure must locate and retain the finalized PCB assembly without reconstructing or approximating the PCB geometry.

Front opening and retention must fit the LT225C7-C08-03 module (17.9 mm x 62.5 mm x 2.36 mm), expose its 14.7972 mm x 55.2948 mm active area, and protect its inactive perimeter while mounted as a horizontal strip.
Four low-profile mechanical keys must be aligned in one row below the display with unobstructed key travel and removable/replaceable keycaps.
Bottom-edge USB-C receptacle must remain fully accessible with plug-shell clearance and strain-resistant enclosure support.
Provide an unobstructed front or top-edge acoustic path from enclosure exterior to the PCB microphone port.

external_references.description: User-provided layout sketch showing the screen above four keys in a compact rectangular body.
Final fabrication PCB STEP and current pcb-cad-handoff.json; required before enclosure modeling.
LT225C7-C08-03 2.25-inch color LCD datasheet; page 4 specifies module size, active area, resolution, SPI interface, and driver IC.

assembly_story.installation: Install the completed PCB assembly into the enclosure, align the display, four switches, USB-C receptacle and microphone port, then close the serviceable enclosure and fit the four keycaps.
assembly_story.maintenance: The enclosure must be reopenable for PCB or switch service without damaging the display or acoustic port.

documents.description: Thin serviceable enclosure assembly around the finalized credit-card-size PCB, display, low-profile keys, microphone port, and USB-C connector.
